The common waste management problems in Housing Board Colony, Palakollu, include:
Irregular Garbage Collection: Inconsistent municipal collection schedules leading to waste accumulation.
Open Waste Dumping: Overflowing public bins and roadside dumping creating unhygienic surroundings and foul odors.
Poor Segregation: Lack of proper separation between wet (biodegradable) and dry (plastic/non-biodegradable) waste at the household level.
Clogged Drainage Systems: Plastic bags and uncollected rubbish clogging open drains, causing waterlogging during rain.
